definition: Augury is a form of divination in which signs or omens are interpreted to gain knowledge believed to come from a superhuman source. In this historical account, augury includes reading chance events or natural occurrences symbolically, such as animal appearances or cries.

provenance.revision: 1901 New York Macmillan original; archive index checked 2026-10-18
provenance.scope: Source record Magic (1) and (2) Divination; pinned source text
